_comment: Kotlin files that have no TypeScript counterpart on purpose. Key: path under the Kotlin root (or test:<path> for tests). Value: why.
settings/JBViewMobileConfigurable.kt: Swing settings page. VS Code renders contributes.configuration from package.json instead.
ui/WrappingLabel.kt: Swing label that wraps text. The webview wraps through CSS.
test:ui/LogPanelTest.kt: IntelliJ platform test of the Swing panel. Pure log logic is covered by test/core/logs*.test.ts.
test:ui/ToolWindowSmokeTest.kt: IntelliJ platform test that builds the tool window. No headless VS Code harness yet; see docs/PORTING.md.
test:ui/ToolsLayoutTest.kt: Tests Swing layout of the tool panel.
